svg.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
svg.aria-label: A Hyprland desktop under a floating waybar. An agent in T3 Code runs broker exec --request for CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, broker's request window asks for a YubiKey touch while the Signal Box lamp in the bar turns to an amber key, and the deploy runs with the token redacted from its output. The lamp fills, and its count climbs to 7 as other grants arrive. A click on it springs the Signal Box panel out: three live grants with their time left, a look at the Register tab with the day's grants and runs, then Revoke all, and the lamp goes dim.
